I'm an atmospheric scientist at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa. My research
group works on cumulus convection, severe weather, and the dynamics that link
small-scale cloud processes to high-impact events — flash floods, lightning,
wildfires.

This site is the informal companion to my
[lab page](https://giuseppetorri.com) — CV, publications, and group info live
there. Here you'll find notes on models and methods, code, talks, and whatever
I'm currently chasing.

*Ciao, vecchio pirata.* 🏴‍☠️
